timing: Retrospective: pinned source results had already been inspected before this plan; controls and local replay procedure are now fixed.
source_pages: 55 nonempty source LP2 segments = site LP2-00..49 plus51..55; append concatenated 12956-rune WHOLE for each key
formula: For each source-named byte/value stream K, reduce every value mod29 and repeat from index0 for every target; sign=-1,+1; Atbash off/on; F interrupter off/on. No-interrupter p=(atbash(c) if chosen else c)+sign*K[i] mod29. Interrupter branch leaves source F unchanged and does not consume K.
score: source Quadgram.score_norm on GP Latin labels, threshold strict score > -5.2; negative only if all source operators and controls pass
forensics: B2 exact XOR: archived A2 token256 against 3 onion256 streams, onion2^3^4 and token^onion2^3^4. Report source entropy bits, printable ratio32..126, first8 bytes and distinct count. No entropy-only hit predicate.
positive_control: For each of 8 sign/Atbash/interrupter operator branches use fixed known English GP plaintext repeated to120 runes under archived A2 all256 key; for interrupter arms replace any plaintext rune whose encrypted rune would be F with literal F so the source skip clock is invertible. Require exact full-120-rune recovery and score>-5.2. Test B2 XOR identity with planted known256 bytes.
input_difference: A2_tokenpad hard-coded archived256 SHA0a3a..., while A2_altbase base60 raw-token decode SHA3b9b...; do not substitute one for other. Base62/64 can exceed255 but source still reduces mod29.
exclusions: Other token edits, key offsets, reset clocks, nonperiodic keys, key-skip beams and unseen onion hex; prior grid records cover different operations.
